content: Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is a dynamic and forward-looking chemical enterprise headquartered in the strategically positioned Lantian Industrial Zone of Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, Wenzhou City, Zhejiang Province—the heartland of China’s thriving private manufacturing and export economy. Established with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, the company specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance specialty chemicals, including industrial solvents, auxiliary agents for coatings and inks, functional additives for plastics and rubber, and environmentally responsible formulations aligned with national green manufacturing standards. Leveraging modern production facilities, ISO-certified quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001), and a robust R&D team, Longchang Chemical consistently delivers customized, cost-effective solutions to clients across domestic and international markets—including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America. The company’s location in the Lantian Industrial Zone affords logistical advantages via proximity to Wenzhou Port and major expressway networks, enabling agile supply chain operations and timely order fulfillment. Committed to responsible stewardship, Longchang Chemical adheres strictly to Chinese environmental regulations (e.g., the MEE’s VOCs control policies) and continuously invests in cleaner production technologies and waste minimization initiatives. With a customer-centric ethos, agile responsiveness, and deep technical expertise, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is steadily building its reputation as a trusted, innovative, and socially conscious partner in the evolving global chemical industry—powering progress while prioritizing people, planet, and performance. (Word count: 228)
